sloka: भ्रातृभिः सह देवाभैः प्रविशस्व स्विकां तनुम् ।यामिच्छसि महाबाहो तां तनुं प्रविश स्विकाम् ।वैष्णवीं तां महातेजस्तद्वाकाशं सनातनम् ।। ७.११०.९ ॥
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ saha devābhaiḥ praviśasva svikāṁ tanum ।yāmicchasi mahābāho tāṁ tanuṁ praviśa svikām ।vaiṣṇavīṁ tāṁ mahātejastadvākāśaṁ sanātanam ।। 7.110.9 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed and greatly effulgent one, enter your own desired form, whether it be with your god-like brothers into your own body, or into that Vaishnava form, or into the eternal sky.
